question: Explain how the business's casual employment of van operators could be contributing to its turnover.
studentResponse: Casual van operators have no guaranteed hours and no paid leave, so their income is uncertain from week to week. That insecurity pushes them to leave when a permanent job with steady hours is offered elsewhere. Each departure means Kerbside Coffee has to recruit and train a replacement, which costs money and time, so casual employment keeps turnover high and expensive.
